# NETWATCH NG

> NETWATCH NG is a Python 3 terminal application for Linux network monitoring and authorized network administration.

## Official resources
- Production product page: https://netwatch-kohl.vercel.app/
- Source repository: https://github.com/sudomarc/NETWATCH
- Main documentation: https://github.com/sudomarc/NETWATCH/blob/main/README.md
- Security policy: https://github.com/sudomarc/NETWATCH/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Contributions: https://github.com/sudomarc/NETWATCH/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Debian/APT installation guide: https://github.com/sudomarc/NETWATCH/blob/main/docs/apt-repository.md
- Signed APT repository: https://sudomarc.github.io/NETWATCH/

## Product summary
NETWATCH NG provides a keyboard-driven TUI/CLI for Linux operators. Implemented areas include:
- Local interface, default-route, gateway and DNS inspection.
- Device discovery using neighbor information and operator-triggered Nmap scans of authorized targets.
- Gateway management-port probes and read-only UPnP/SSDP inspection of the configured gateway.
- Wi-Fi radio and access-point inventory using optional Aircrack-ng tools.
- Explicitly confirmed Netfilter firewall operations.
- Traffic policing with Linux `tc`; excess packets are dropped rather than smoothly queued.
- Ping, traceroute, DNS diagnostics and JSON/CSV device exports.

## Important limitations
- NETWATCH NG does not crack Wi-Fi keys, inject frames, or deauthenticate stations.
- It does not provide SNMP discovery or detailed device firmware fingerprinting.
- It does not implement HTB/smooth traffic shaping; its traffic-control behavior is packet policing.
- It does not automatically update itself or execute downloaded code.
- Optional system tools may be required for some features. Missing tools are reported as unavailable rather than simulated.

## Intended use
Use NETWATCH NG only on networks you own or are authorized to administer. Consult the repository README and security policy for supported behavior, privileges and operational risks.

## Version
The website currently presents version 2.1.1. Verify the repository's latest stable release before quoting a newer version.
